<!--
Example harmonization configs (YAML) for two trials, stacked so trial Y
covers trial X on a fragment. Pulled into the deck with an include
shortcode pointing at this file.
-->
:::: {.r-stack}

::: {.harmonization-config}
Demographics config for trial X
```{.yaml code-line-numbers="1,2|5-7|" style="font-size: 1.2em;"}
unique_subject_id:
  - {file: adsl.csv, column: USUBJID, data_type: character}
site_id:
  - {file: adsl.csv, column: SITE, data_type: character}
baseline_height_cm:
  - {file: adsl.csv, column: HEIGHTBL, data_type: numeric,
     numeric_units: inch}
diagnosis_date:
  - {file: adsl.csv, column: DIAGDTC, data_type: character}
actual_arm:
  - {file: adsl.csv, column: ACTARM, data_type: character}
```
:::

::: {.harmonization-config .config-cover .fragment}
Demographics config for trial Y
```{.yaml style="font-size: 1.2em;"}
unique_subject_id:
  - {file: dm.csv, column: subject_id, data_type: character}
site_id:
  - {file: dm.csv, column: SITE_ID, data_type: character}
diagnosis_date:
  - {file: dm.csv, column: DIAGDTC, data_type: character}
actual_arm:
  - {file: dm.csv, column: study_arm, data_type: character}
```
:::

::::
